single_new_mechanism.description: After each certified R47J R33/affine/RUP normalization fixpoint, invoke the already-existing R42 subsumption-aware BVE selector. If a certified SA-BVE exists, apply it, independently replay it, and restart the same R47J normalization. Stop only at semantic terminal or a joint R33/affine/RUP/SA-BVE fixpoint.
single_new_mechanism.reason: The pre-DP state is an SA-BVE fixpoint, but exact DP plus RUP can alter subsumption and occurrence structure and may create a new certified SA-BVE opportunity. R47J does not re-run the R42 SA-BVE selector after DP.

frozen_test.scan: all bipolar pivots of the sealed R47K reachable residual fixpoint in canonical variable order
frozen_test.required_regression: R47J alone still has zero accepted pivots on this exact core
required_integrity: every changing normalization or SA-BVE step strictly decreases current CLV
SAT reconstruction replays to the sealed input whenever a SAT terminal is reached

resource_envelope.argument: R47J closure already has a polynomial CLV-state height bound. Each added SA-BVE is discovered by polynomial all-variable exact-DP/subsumption scanning and must strictly decrease the current CLV before restart. No fresh variables are introduced. Therefore the number of added restarts is bounded by the same finite CLV-state envelope relative to the forced-DP formula, and each restart has polynomial work.

interpretation_ceiling: A rescue would improve the current grammar and refute only the claim that R47K is dead under closure of all already-existing reducers. A failure would isolate a stronger obstruction. Neither outcome proves O4 universally.
